name: Sakurai Sadao
source:
[url=/c5240]Kanade[/url]'s father and owner of Studio 696. His nickname is "Master".

Although he was an amazing drummer in the past, he's semi-retired now, thanks to his chronic hip pain.
Because of his strong, kind support of music, rock, and those who love them, Master is well liked by many.
